title: 第152章 找到工作
slug: 穿越民国获得每日签到系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

天还没亮透，法租界巷子里的青石板还蒙着一层薄薄的白霜。

赵小毛娘轻手轻脚地起了床，生怕弄出一点动静。

她走到灶台前，就着凉水胡乱抹了把脸，把昨晚剩下的半块冷饼子用油纸仔细包好，贴着胸口揣进怀里。

那点体温，刚好能把饼子焐得软和些。

这几天她跑断了腿，可处处碰壁。

昨天去一家纱厂，人家嫌她年纪大，手脚不利索，连门都没让她进；

前天去饭馆洗碗，老板娘上下打量了她一眼，撇着嘴说：“侬这副病恹恹的样子，别倒在我们店里。”

她咬着牙没吭声，可心里像被针扎一样。

出了门，冷风直往领口里灌。

她缩着脖子，沿着霞飞路往东走。

四十分钟的路，她走得脚底板发麻。

到了洋行门口，那块画着船锚的铜牌在灰蒙蒙的天色下泛着冷光。

门口已经站了七八个女人，年纪大的头发花白，年纪小的也裹着破棉袄，一个个缩着脖子，冻得直跺脚。

赵小毛娘默默站到队尾，把手深深插进袖筒里。

前面两个女人正压着嗓子嘀咕。

一个叹着气说：“听讲只招一个，七八个人抢，哪能轮得到咱？”

另一个搓着冻僵的手，苦笑一声：“轮不到也得试试啊，屋里厢米缸都见底了，再不找点进项，一家老小喝西北风去？”

赵小毛娘听着，没搭腔。

她摸了摸怀里贴着心口的饼子，心里盘算着：要是真能留下，哪怕只给一口热饭。

她也能省下自己那份，全带回去给小毛吃。

“吱呀”一声，厚重的木门开了。

一个穿西装的瘦高个走出来，领带系得歪歪扭扭，嘴里还叼着根没点燃的烟。

他眯着眼，目光像刀子一样在门口这群女人身上刮了一圈。

“就招一个。试一天，扫后院仓库。谁干得干净利落，留谁。”

人群里顿时响起一阵压抑的叹息，有人小声嘟囔：“一个？这哪抢得过啊……”

瘦高个没理会，转身往里走。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

It's not bright yet, and the bluestone slabs in the alleys of the French Concession are still covered with a thin layer of white frost.

Zhao Xiaomao got up quietly, for fear of making any noise.

She walked to the stove, wiped her face with cold water, carefully wrapped the half piece of cold pancake left last night in oil paper, and put it close to her chest in her arms.

That little bit of body temperature is just enough to make the pancakes softer.

In the past few days, she broke her leg while running, but she encountered obstacles everywhere.

Yesterday I went to a cotton factory. People thought she was old and unwieldy, so they didn't even let her in.

The day before yesterday, when I went to the restaurant to wash dishes, the proprietress looked her up and down, curled her lips and said, "You look so sick, don't fall down in our store."

She gritted her teeth and said nothing, but her heart felt like being pricked by needles.

When I walked out of the door, the cold wind blew straight into my collar.

She shrunk her neck and walked east along Xiafei Road.

The forty minutes of walking made the soles of her feet numb.

When we arrived at the entrance of the foreign bank, the bronze plate with the anchor painted on it shone coldly under the gray sky.

There were already seven or eight women standing at the door. The older ones had gray hair, while the younger ones were also wrapped in ragged cotton-padded jackets. All of them were hunching their necks and stamping their feet from the cold.

Zhao Xiaomao stood silently at the end of the line and put her hands deeply into her sleeves.

The two women in front were muttering under their breath.

One of them sighed and said, "We only recruit one person to attend the lecture. Seven or eight people are competing for it. How can we get our turn?"

The other one rubbed his frozen hands and smiled bitterly: "You have to give it a try even if it's not your turn. The rice jars in the house are all bottomed out. If we don't find some income, will the whole family go to drink the northwest wind?"

Madam Zhao Xiaomao listened and said nothing.

She touched the pancake close to her heart and thought: If she could really stay, even if it was just a mouthful of hot rice.

She could also save her share and take it all back to Xiaomao.

With a "squeak" sound, the heavy wooden door opened.

A tall and thin man in a suit came out, his tie was tied crookedly, and there was an unlit cigarette in his mouth.

He squinted his eyes, and his eyes were like knives scratching around the group of women at the door.

"Just hire one. Try it for a day and clean the backyard warehouse. Whoever does the job cleanly will be retained."

Suddenly there was a suppressed sigh in the crowd, and someone whispered: "One? How can you win over this..."

The tall and thin man ignored it, turned around and walked inside.
